title: Scan-Inserted Counter
constraints: Functional mode (`se = 0`): a 4-bit up counter with enable, wrapping 15 → 0. `tc` (terminal count) = 1 when `count == 15`, combinational.
Scan mode (`se = 1`): the 4 counter flops become a shift chain, `count <= {count[2:0], si}` (enable ignored). `so = count[3]`.
Synchronous reset clears the counter. Must be synthesizable.
hints: Take the functional next state, `en ? count + 1 : count`, and put the scan mux after it.
A typical ATPG test: shift in 1110 (4 scan edges), one functional capture edge with en = 1 (→ 1111, tc = 1), then shift out and compare.
Scan lets the tester reach count = 15 in 4 cycles instead of 15, which matters for 32-bit counters.
